newsitem.title: GERMANY: IMF's Camdessus to attend G7 Berlin meeting.
newsitem.headline: IMF's Camdessus to attend G7 Berlin meeting.

text.p: The German finance ministry said on Thursday that IMF managing director Michel Camdessus would attend the planned meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers and central bank governors in Berlin on February 8.
The ministry said in a statement that the focus of the talks, announced earlier this month, would be "the traditional exchange of views over the current position of the world economy".
It added: "The managing director of the International Monetary Fund, Michel Camdessus, will give the IMF's analysis of the position and present the IMF's recommendations on economic policy."
The G7 groups Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States.
